code:
1. Is the cost dominated by large, parallelizable matmul?
     no  -> start with CPU
2. Does it fit the memory math (Ch.1 L2) on a real instance,
   or does it need LoRA / quantization / multi-GPU sharding?
3. Single-node (NC/G-series) or multi-node (ND/P-series)?
4. Enough sustained load to keep the GPU busy at this volume?
caption: Forcing a large training job onto CPU to 'save cost' often costs more in wall-clock time than the GPU would have.
